record.original_question: Let T113(a,b;3) denote the weighted sum of all tilings of the (a,b)-benzel when both stone orientations and all three bone orientations are allowed, where a tiling with m stones has weight 3^m. Is the sequence T113(n, 2n-3; 3), defined for n >= 4, 2-adically continuous as a function of n?

evidence.quote: Let Tijk (a, b; 3) denote the weighted sum of the i, j, k tilings of the (a, b)-benzel as defined near the end of section 1, where a tiling with m stones has weight 3^m.
Problem 18: Is T113 (n, 2n - 3; 3) 2-adically continuous as a function of n >= 4?
The sequence appears to be constant mod 2, constant mod 4, 2-periodic mod 8, and 8-periodic mod 16.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of "benzel" regions in the triangular lattice indexed by pairs of positive integers $(a,b)$. A benzel can be tiled using two kinds of pieces: "stones" (with two possible orientations) and "bones" (with three possible orientations). For nonnegative integers $i,j,k \in \{0,1\}$ (with at least one nonzero), let $T_{ijk}(a,b)$ denote the set of tilings of the $(a,b)$-benzel that use stones in (any of) the orientations indicated by $i$ and $j$ and bones in the orientations indicated by $k$ (so $T_{113}(a,b)$ allows both stone orientations and all three bone orientations).

For a positive integer parameter, define the weighted tiling count
$$T_{113}(a,b;3) \;=\; \sum_{\tau} 3^{m(\tau)},$$
where the sum runs over all tilings $\tau$ of the $(a,b)$-benzel that use both stone orientations and all three bone orientations, and $m(\tau)$ is the number of stones in $\tau$.

A function $f:\mathbb{Z}_{\ge N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ is said to be \emph{$2$-adically continuous} if it extends to a continuous function from $\mathbb{Z}_2$ to $\mathbb{Z}_2$; equivalently, for every $k\ge 0$ there exists $M$ such that whenever $n\equiv n'\pmod{2^M}$ (with $n,n'\ge N$), one has $f(n)\equiv f(n')\pmod{2^k}$.

Question: Is the sequence $\bigl(T_{113}(n,2n-3;3)\bigr)_{n\ge 4}$ $2$-adically continuous as a function of $n$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a list of enumeration-of-tilings problems related to weighted benzel tilings. Searches surface related works on benzel tilings (e.g., generalized compression methods and a pentagonal number theorem for tribone tilings) but no resolution of the 2-adic continuity question for the weighted T113(n,2n-3;3) sequence. The empirical mod-2^k periodicity observations support the conjecture, but no proof appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Tilings of benzels via generalized compression
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on benzel tilings extending earlier enumeration results.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work on benzel tilings does not address the 2-adic continuity of T113(n,2n-3;3).

status_evidence.title: A pentagonal number theorem for tribone tilings
status_evidence.snippet: Treats tribone tilings of benzels but not weighted T113 2-adic continuity.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the weighted T113 2-adic continuity question is given.

status_evidence.title: Jim Propp's Benzel Tilings Site
status_evidence.snippet: Project page collecting open problems and results on benzel tilings.
status_evidence.claim: Acts as a hub for benzel-tiling problems including unresolved 2-adic continuity questions.
